definitions.explanation: A person who belongs to and forms part of a group, organization, or society. More formal and academic than everyday words for 'member.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成員|せいいん}⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Each member of the family has a role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成員|せいいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす→責任を果たす：21268_sekininwohatasu⟧。
examples.english: To fulfill one's responsibility as a member of society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成員|せいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧⟦{意思|いし}{決定|けってい}→意思決定：26876_ishikettei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As the number of members in the organization grows, decision-making becomes more difficult.

notes:
A formal, somewhat academic term for a member or constituent of a group. Most commonly encountered in sociology, political science, and formal writing. Unlike ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧, which implies formal enrollment, {成員|せいいん} emphasizes being a constituent part of a collective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成員|せいいん}: member of society
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成員|せいいん}: family member
- ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成員|せいいん}: member of an organization
- ⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成員|せいいん}: member of a group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧: member — casual loanword used in everyday speech
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: member — implies formal registration or membership (in a club, association, etc.)
- ⟦{構成員|こうせいいん}→構成員：15240_kouseiin⟧: constituent member — more technical, emphasizes the structural role within an organization
- ⟦{一員|いちいん}→一員：08920_ichiin⟧: one member (of) — emphasizes being part of a larger whole
